# Prompt master (Nidhin Joseph Nelson)

Writes or fixes a prompt tuned for a specific AI tool.

- Source: https://github.com/nidhinjs/prompt-master
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nidhinjs/prompt-master/main/SKILL.md
- Author: Nidhin Joseph Nelson
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/prompt-master-nidhin-joseph-nelson-e6cb241f

Activates only when you ask for a prompt. Claude confirms the target tool (a chat model, Cursor, a coding agent, an image or video model), extracts the intent with at most three clarifying questions, and returns one ready-to-paste prompt with a one-line note on what it optimized. It prefers simple techniques such as roles, examples and verification criteria over complex reasoning frameworks, and reference files cover tool-specific guidance.

**Try asking:**
- "Write a Midjourney prompt for a product shot of a ceramic mug on a wooden table"
- "Fix this Cursor prompt so it stops rewriting unrelated files"
- "Turn my rough idea into a system prompt for a support chatbot"

**Source:** [nidhinjs/prompt-master](https://github.com/nidhinjs/prompt-master) · MIT · by Nidhin Joseph Nelson
